description: This file defines an object 'WakeWords' that manages wake word configurations, including parsing comma-separated lists, detecting changes, and sanitizing input words with constraints on maximum number and length.

methods.name: parseCommaSeparated
methods.description: Splits an input string by commas into a list of trimmed, non-empty strings.

methods.name: parseIfChanged
methods.description: Parses the input string into a list and returns it only if it differs from the current list.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Cleans a list of words by trimming, filtering empty strings, enforcing maximum size, and maximum word length, or returns default if resulting list is empty.
